property_summary: After any CashOut call, balance changes for the caller are non-positive

The caller's balance never becomes zero after a CashOut call; the reference allows full withdrawal to zero, but the mutant prevents it, so the rule is that there exists an input where the caller's balance is zero after CashOut.
After a CashOut call that does not revert, the caller's balance is strictly less than its previous balance, and the difference equals the withdrawn amount.
For any caller and amount, after a successful CashOut, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the amount withdrawn.
After any sequence of deposits and a cash-out, the total supply (sum of all balances plus contract balance) equals the contract's total received ether.
After any call to CashOut that reverts, the caller's balance at the same key (the caller) must remain unchanged from before the call.
After any successful CashOut, the balance of the caller decreases by exactly the amount withdrawn, regardless of whether the external call succeeds.
After executing CashOut, the balance of the caller is less than or equal to its pre-call value when the call succeeds.
After any sequence of calls ending with CashOut, the caller's balance in the contract never exceeds the total amount they deposited
The total sum of balances held by the contract never decreases after a CashOut call (i.e., the sum of all balances stays the same or increases).
After any call to CashOut, the contract balance minus the caller's balances entry is unchanged (i.e., sum of all other balances stays the same).
After any sequence of calls ending with CashOut, the contract's balance minus the sum of all user balances is always zero.
After any call to CashOut, the total Ether held by the contract is at least the sum of all user balances.
After a CashOut call, MinDeposit is unchanged from its initial value.
The initial MinDeposit value is preserved after any sequence of operations ending with CashOut.
After any sequence of calls ending with CashOut, MinDeposit equals 1 ether (the reference initial value).
MinDeposit must be exactly 1 ether after any CashOut call.
MinDeposit is never modified after deployment.
After any sequence of deposits and a final CashOut, the total supply (sum of balances plus contract balance) remains unchanged from the initial contract balance before the sequence.
After any sequence of deposits and a final CashOut, if msg.value >= MinDeposit then Deposit increases the sender's balance, but if msg.value == MinDeposit the buggy version skips it.
After any sequence of deposits and a final CashOut, the contract's balance change equals the net of deposits and withdrawals.
After any deposit to reach a target balance and a final CashOut for the full balance, the sender's balance in the contract is zero only if they deposited at least MinDeposit.
After any deposit followed by a CashOut for the entire balance, the sender's balance is zero if and only if the deposit amount was >= MinDeposit.
After any sequence of deposits and cashouts, the contract's balance never exceeds the sum of all user balances.
After any sequence of deposits and cashouts, the sum of balances[caller] for all possible callers never exceeds the contract's Ether balance.
For any caller, after a CashOut, the caller's balance is never greater than before the CashOut.
After any sequence of deposits and cashouts, the balance of the contract (in wei) is always greater than or equal to the sum of all user balances recorded in the mapping.
After any sequence of deposits and cashouts, the caller's balance after CashOut is never greater than before CashOut.
After a CashOut call that succeeds, the sender's balance before the call equals the sum of their balance after the call and the amount withdrawn.
After a successful CashOut, the sum of the caller's balance and contract's balance is invariant.
After any sequence of deposits and cashouts, calling CashOut(0) never reverts when the caller has a positive balance.
After a successful CashOut call, the Depositor's balance in the contract is not increased by the CashOut amount.
After a successful CashOut call, the caller's balance in the Log contract's History does not increase.
The sum of balance of the caller after a CashOut call is never greater than the sum before the CashOut call plus the amount withdrawn.
The Deposit state variable (MinDeposit) is never increased after a CashOut call.
After a CashOut call, the balance of the caller does not exceed the sum of its previous balance and the amount withdrawn.
After a CashOut call, the balance of the caller is never greater than the balance before the call.
After any sequence of operations ending with CashOut, the balance of the caller never exceeds its balance before the CashOut call minus the amount withdrawn.
Balances never increase after a CashOut call
After CashOut, the sender's balance strictly decreases (i.e., is less than before).
After a CashOut call, the sum of all balances in the contract (mapping) plus the contract's Ether balance does not increase.
After a CashOut call, the caller's balance in the contract never exceeds the amount they previously had available before the call.
After a CashOut call, the contract's total balance (sum of all user balances plus contract Ether) does not increase.
After any sequence of deposits and cashouts, the contract's total balance equals the sum of all user balances, and each user can cash out up to their balance.
After any call to CashOut with amount equal to the caller's balance, the transaction must succeed (not revert) and the caller's balance becomes zero.
A user can always cash out an amount equal to their full balance, resulting in a zero balance afterward.
When a user cashes out their entire balance (amount equal to balance), the CashOut call must succeed (not revert).
After a CashOut call for an amount equal to the caller's balance, the caller's balance becomes zero and the call does not revert.
After any CashOut call, the contract's effective balance change equals the amount withdrawn.
After a successful CashOut, the caller's balance decreases by the withdrawn amount.
After any CashOut call, the total supply (sum of all balances plus contract balance) remains unchanged for the reference contract, but increases for the mutant.
After a successful CashOut, the contract's own ether balance decreases by exactly the withdrawn amount.
After a successful CashOut call, the balance of the caller decreases by exactly the withdrawn amount.
